prebossNodes.description: Number of pre-boss depths visited on a path; branching alternatives do not add levels.

restsPerAct.description: Number of mandatory rest depths; each rest depth has one visible node shared by every path.

branchColumns.description: Number of lanes at non-rest depths. Rest and boss nodes merge the lanes.

minimumThreatFloor.description: Earliest depth that may contain an elite or the final boss.

mapMode.description: Map visibility policy for configured routes; fog reveals the trail and next choices.

firstFloor.description: Node type every lane on depth 1 is forced to; null leaves depth 1 to the ordinary draw. It must be one of the route's alternatives, and depth 1 cannot also be a rest depth.

shopShare.description: Share of randomly typed nodes (not rest, elite, boss or the forced first floor) that are shops; the rest keep the even event/fight/treasure split. Absent keeps the even draw over every alternative.

maxBranches.description: Present: after a shared opening depth the act splits into 1..min(maxBranches, distinct bosses) branches, each with its own lanes, rests, elites and boss. Absent keeps a single trunk with one boss.

startNodeRefills.description: Entering the branched map's single start node (one that carries refill: true) restores HP to full and refills both flasks. Only the branched generator (maxBranches) reads it. Default true.

requirePrebossRest.description: Require the last preboss depth to be a mandatory rest on every route.

typeWeights.description: Present: a free node (not rest, not forced, not a guaranteed slot) is a weighted draw over the listed types permitted at its depth (elite only at or past minimumThreatFloor); shopShare is ignored. Only the branched generator reads it. null means absent.

variedNeighbours.description: True: a free node may not repeat the type of the node already made in the neighbouring lane of the same branch and depth, when another permitted type has positive weight. null means absent.

shopsPerBranch.description: 1: each branch gets one guaranteed shop slot on a non-rest depth 4-8 where one of its lanes exists, never on a guaranteed elite slot. null means absent.

forkPercent.description: Chance per boundary node per depth that a branch widens outward. Absent keeps 40. null means absent.

crossLinkPercent.description: Present: for every gap between two in-branch depths and every pair of neighbouring lanes present on both, one draw at this percentage adds one diagonal edge (direction 50/50, never crossing another edge). Replaces the single remerge draw per branch and gap. null means absent.
